answer: Sybil resistance comes from identity-bound stake: every agent must lock collateral before it may vote or mine. A farm of fake wallets needs one full bond each, so its cost grows linearly while honest rewards do not. If a violet badge is seen to wander between accounts, or a reef of clones votes as one, the validator slashes every linked bond. To control ten percent of decisions an attacker must lock ten percent of all stake, making forged identities far pricier than earned ones.
